title: Expiry is mandatory on issuance
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; HCERT Specification, 6.1 HCERT Signature Validity Time.

statements.label: Expiry is mandatory on issuance
statements.requirement: The issuer API SHALL require an explicit validity (exp, or a validity period) and SHALL have no default of "never expires". exp is the only revocation mechanism.

sources.quote: exp is the only revocation mechanism this specification offers
